start: Owner signed in, Today, a gym with months of members, payments and visits

steps.action: Read 'Your numbers' and change 'Days to show'
user_sees: Tiles: plans ending, fees owed, stopped coming, new members, busiest hour, each with a small trend line
'Last <n> days, and plans ending in the next <n>. Tap a number to see who is behind it.'
must_not: A tile whose number differs from the list behind it
NaN or a minus count

user_sees: Page with 'Plans that end and are not renewed yet · <days>', 'How it changed' with 'Highest' and 'Now', and the members with '<plan> · ends in 3 days (<date>)'
'Back to Today'
must_not: A renewed member still listed
Pass members listed

steps.action: Open Your growth from the menu
user_sees: Title 'Your growth', 'Is your gym growing? Month by month, before and since MettleUp.'
'Started on MettleUp: <date>. These numbers show what changed since you started, not why. …'
'How these numbers are counted'
must_not: This month shown as a full month without 'So far'
Money that was refunded counted as income

steps.action: Tap 'Share this report' then 'Print or save as PDF'
user_sees: Page 'Share this report' 'One page to print, or to save as a PDF and send.'
The browser's print box with one page
must_not: Menu and buttons printed on the page
A second page with one line

start: Owner opens /numbers/owed/30 from a saved link, and downloads

user_sees: 'Fees members still have to pay' with each member, owed since, days and amount
must_not: A total that differs from Money > Dues

user_sees: 'Downloaded <n> members.' with headers Member, Mobile, Plans unpaid, Owed since, Days, Amount owed (INR), Archived
must_not: 'Downloaded 1 members.'
Amounts in paise

steps.action: On Your growth tap 'Download Excel file'
user_sees: 'Downloaded <n> months.'
must_not: Months missing from the file that are on the page

start: Owner of a gym made today, no members

user_sees: 'No plans end in these days', 'Nobody owes money' 'Every plan is fully paid.', 'Start checking members in', 'Nobody joined in these days' 'Pick more days at the top to look further back.'
must_not: 'Everybody is coming' when the register was never used
A blank chart frame

steps.action: Set 'From' after 'To' in the custom days
user_sees: A plain correction or the dates swapped
must_not: A minus range and wrong totals

user_sees: 'To compare with before MettleUp, add your old records' with 'Add old records'
must_not: A growth percent from one month
Divide-by-zero figures

start: Owner looks at the numbers, then a payment is taken and old records are added

steps.action: Take a member's dues in full, come back to Today
user_sees: Fees owed goes down by that amount; the member leaves the list
must_not: The old figure until a reload

steps.action: Import old records, open Your growth again
user_sees: Months 'Before MettleUp' appear; the compare cards change from first-months-versus-latest to before-versus-since
must_not: The 'Started MettleUp' month moved

user_sees: The page goes back to the earlier compare
must_not: Old months left behind

start: Owner prints the report to send to a partner

user_sees: Totals by month only
must_not: Member names or mobile numbers on the shared page
Another branch's figures mixed in without saying so

user_sees: The people tiles: plans ending, stopped coming, new members, busiest hour
must_not: The fees-owed tile or any money total for the desk

user_sees: 'Members with a plan who stopped coming' and the list, with a WhatsApp action per member
must_not: Money owed per member shown here to the desk

user_sees: 'Only an owner can see this' 'Ask your gym owner if you need something from here.'
must_not: The growth page or the owed list drawn for a moment before the refusal
A 'Your growth' link in the desk's menu

start: Front desk checks members in, then looks at the numbers

steps.action: Check five members in, open the busiest-hour tile
user_sees: 'Check-ins by hour' and 'Hours, busiest first' include the new check-ins
must_not: 'No check-in times yet' after timed check-ins exist

user_sees: 'Downloaded the hours.'
must_not: A file with member names for an hours list

start: Front desk and the promise that only the owner sees growth

steps.action: Open any page, with the browser's saved records on the device
user_sees: No money totals on any desk page
must_not: The desk able to add up the gym's income from what the panel shows
